calls.title: GROWTHBOOK INC x Rippling | Renewal
calls.summary: The discussion clarified the role of Account Manager Karoline, who serves as the primary contact for contractual agreements and platform guidance, managing renewals and support escalation processes. Jennifer highlighted current HR practices focused on hiring and payroll accuracy using Rippling, expressing interest in its automation capabilities and further employee benefits options. The company plans to increase full-time employees and explore global remote hiring opportunities. Renewal pricing options were addressed, including a standard increase and multi-year agreements to mitigate costs. Billing discrepancies between payroll and HR platform counts were noted, with a commitment to resolve them, and the manual nature of performance review processes was discussed, with suggestions for leveraging Rippling's integrated tools.
calls.keywords: Rippling, Renewal, PEO, Global Contractor, Workflow Automation, Subscription Billing
